FAQ

Common questions about research-use sourcing, warehouse options, documentation, account access, and kits.

Are products for research use only?

Yes. Products are intended for laboratory research use only. They are not for human consumption, diagnosis, treatment, cure, or disease prevention.

What is the difference between US Warehouse and Overseas Warehouse?

US Warehouse is intended for faster fulfillment and domestic availability. Overseas Warehouse is intended for planned sourcing, bulk-friendly value, and longer timelines.

What is the typical Overseas Warehouse delivery timeline?

Current site copy uses 7–14 day delivery as the planning estimate. Timelines are not guaranteed and can vary by product, destination, documentation needs, and fulfillment conditions.

Do products include COAs or third-party testing?

Documentation/testing may be available on select products. Availability can vary by product, batch, and sourcing path. Optional upgraded testing may affect fulfillment or shipping timelines.

Why do I need to register before accessing Shop Peptides?

Registration supports responsible product access, researcher verification, account history, shipment tracking, and a cleaner support workflow. Shop access remains locked until registration and email verification are complete.

How does email verification unlock the shop?

In the prototype, the verification link is simulated. In production, the registration system should send a secure email link. Clicking that link returns the user to Pep Suppliers and unlocks product access after verification.

Can I order research kits?

Yes. The site includes research kit options and a Build Your Kit inquiry flow. Kit requests are for research-use sourcing inquiries only and should be verified for availability before launch.

Can I order in bulk?

Bulk planning may be supported depending on product availability, warehouse path, documentation needs, and quantity. Use the contact form to provide product names, MG per vial, warehouse preference, and target quantity.

Can Pep Suppliers provide dosing guidance?

No. Pep Suppliers cannot provide medical advice, dosing guidance, human-use guidance, treatment recommendations, or disease-related claims.

How should I contact Pep Suppliers?

Use the sourcing inquiry form for the cleanest routing. You may also contact info@pep-suppliers.com or call 212 390 8775. The New York sourcing office is listed as 305 West Broadway, Ste 201, New York, NY 10002.

"}; function escAttr(s){ return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/"/g,'"'); } function renderCard(p){ var inner = CARD_INNER_HTML[p.id]; if (!inner) return ''; var attrs = p.dataAttributes || {}; var attrStr = ' class="product-card expanded-product" data-id="' + escAttr(p.id) + '"'; Object.keys(attrs).forEach(function(k){ attrStr += ' ' + k + '="' + escAttr(attrs[k]) + '"'; }); return '' + inner + ''; } document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){ var grid = document.getElementById('products-grid'); if (!grid) return; fetch('/products.json') .then(function(r){ return r.json(); }) .then(function(items){ window._products = items; var visible = items.filter(function(p){ return p.visible === true; }); grid.innerHTML = visible.map(renderCard).join('\n'); // Update category counts from live data var catMap = {'Weight Management':'fc-weight','Recovery & Healing':'fc-recovery','Hormone Support':'fc-hormone','Other Research':'fc-other','Peptide Blends':'fc-blends','Research Kits':'fc-kits'}; var overseas = visible.filter(function(p){ return p.warehouse === 'Overseas Warehouse'; }); // Update counts dynamically var el = document.getElementById('fc-all'); if(el) el.textContent = overseas.length; Object.keys(catMap).forEach(function(cat){ var c = overseas.filter(function(p){ return p.category === cat; }).length; var e = document.getElementById(catMap[cat]); if(e) e.textContent = c; }); // Render grid function renderGrid(cat) { var filtered = cat ? overseas.filter(function(p){ return p.category === cat; }) : overseas; grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(renderCard).join('\n'); // Re-attach size pill active state grid.querySelectorAll('.size-pill:first-child').forEach(function(pill){ pill.classList.add('active'); }); } // Filter row click handler var filterRows = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-row'); filterRows.forEach(function(row) { row.addEventListener('click', function() { filterRows.forEach(function(r){ r.classList.remove('active'); }); row.classList.add('active'); var cat = row.getAttribute('data-cat') || null; renderGrid(cat); }); }); // Initial render (all) renderGrid(null); }) .catch(function(err){ console.error('products.json load failed', err); }); }); })();
